page: Microsoft Azure M84pds_v4 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance based on the ARM64 architecture and managed by Microsoft Hyper-V. It is provisioned with 84 dedicated vCPUs and 1344.0 GB of system memory, delivering a high memory-to-core ratio of 16.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware acceleration via discrete GPUs is not present in this configuration.

For high-throughput temporary data and high IOPS workloads, the instance integrates 4725 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. The platform is Premium Storage capable, allowing attachment to performance-tiered remote disk storage. The instance configuration includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, necessitating standard virtual network configuration for external connectivity.

The ARM-based compute architecture delivers resource density and power efficiency for massive memory allocations, though it requires workloads and runtime dependencies to be compiled for ARM64 platforms. M84pds_v4 is suited for large-scale in-memory databases, distributed caching layers, heavy extract-transform-load (ETL) processing, and real-time enterprise data analytics.
